title: Doctoral Programmes (2026/2027, 2nd call)
institution: Instituto Superior Técnico, Universidade de Lisboa
field: Engineering, science and technology doctoral programmes
about: Instituto Superior Técnico (University of Lisbon) holds the second application call for its 2026/2027 doctoral programmes from 30 November 2026 to 10 January 2027, via the Connect platform, with enrolment from 25 January to 5 February 2027.
requirements: Applications submitted online only, through the Connect platform
Applications can be sent at any time but are reviewed only during the stipulated periods
Registration and enrolment for the 2nd round: 25 January - 5 February 2027

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: The record's requirements ("Applications submitted online only, through the Connect platform", "Applications can be sent at any time but are reviewed only during the stipulated periods") are application logistics that no course objective covers; the top shortlist scores (A018.07, A014.03) come from incidental term matches ("technology", "platform", "application", "call"), not genuine coverage, and the field is a broad engineering, science and technology doctoral call, so this links to the EduCut AI Academy course catalog rather than a specific course
